title: Android RadioGroup: selection events
purpose: Check that the host receives RadioGroup selection-change notifications for direct taps and programmatic selection or clearing.
changes: The host can drain a bounded queue of group selection events. The example displays the latest event below the two choices.
steps: Under Nested initial choice, tap Direct choice. The message below the choices should say Group event: direct choice.
Tap Clear group selection. The message should change to Group event: cleared.
Tap Select nested by ID. The message should change to Group event: nested choice.
Turn on right-to-left layout and repeat. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with details and your device.
expected: Each supported group selection or clear produces a matching host event. The initial XML selection does not produce an event.
limits: Events are queued during rendering rather than delivered through a synchronous Android listener. Nested buttons tapped independently do not generate a group event; Android device timing remains unverified.

references.scope: Checked-change notification, repeated check and clear behavior.

validation: Seven nested RadioGroup tests, 197 Android XML tests and 158 importer tests passed, including event deduplication, repeated clears, unknown IDs and queue bounds.
A 320 × 720 browser test checked event text in LTR and RTL; programmatic selection regression also passed.
